testCases.name: Functional Application Test
testCases.description: Verify the application has actual functionality beyond basic placeholder content
steps: Check for interactive elements (forms, buttons, input fields)
Confirm application has real features, not just 'Vite + React' placeholder text
Verify professional UI design with TailwindCSS styling
testCases.expectedOutcome: Application displays functional authentication system with login/register forms, not a placeholder page
testCases.failureCondition: If page only shows 'Vite + React' placeholder or has no interactive elements, this test should FAIL

testCases.name: UI Components Functionality Test
testCases.description: Test that UI components are properly implemented and interactive
steps: Verify login form is visible with email and password fields
Check for 'Sign in' and 'Sign up' toggle button
Test form inputs are functional and accept user input
Verify buttons are clickable and respond to hover states
Check for loading spinners during authentication
Verify error message display area exists
testCases.expectedOutcome: All UI components render correctly and respond to user interactions with proper styling

testCases.name: Content Quality and Design Test
testCases.description: Verify application has meaningful content and professional appearance
steps: Verify proper heading structure ('Sign in to your account' / 'Create your account')
Check for professional color scheme (blue accent colors)
Verify responsive design on different screen sizes
Confirm proper spacing and layout using TailwindCSS
Check for accessibility features (labels, ARIA attributes)
Verify no placeholder or lorem ipsum text
testCases.expectedOutcome: Application demonstrates professional design with meaningful, production-ready content

testCases.name: User Registration Flow
testCases.description: Test complete user registration process from form submission to successful account creation
steps: Click 'Don't have an account? Sign up' link to toggle to registration mode
Verify registration form shows name, email, and password fields
Enter valid email: 'testuser@example.com' (use unique email per test)
Verify loading state displays during registration
Confirm successful registration redirects to dashboard
Verify JWT token is stored in localStorage
Confirm user data is visible in dashboard
testCases.expectedOutcome: User successfully registers, receives JWT token, and is redirected to authenticated dashboard with user information displayed
testCases.failureCondition: Registration fails, error displayed, or user not redirected to dashboard

testCases.name: User Login Flow
testCases.description: Test user login with existing credentials
steps: Verify login form is in login mode (not registration)
Confirm successful login redirects to dashboard
Confirm user name and email displayed in dashboard
testCases.expectedOutcome: User successfully logs in and is redirected to dashboard with authentication token stored
testCases.failureCondition: Login fails with valid credentials or no redirect occurs

testCases.name: User Logout Flow
testCases.description: Test user logout functionality and session clearing
steps: Verify 'Sign out' button is visible in navigation
Verify user is redirected to login page
Confirm JWT token is removed from localStorage
Verify Zustand store is cleared of user data
testCases.expectedOutcome: User successfully logs out, all authentication data cleared, and protected routes become inaccessible
testCases.failureCondition: User remains logged in, token persists, or can access protected routes after logout

testCases.name: Protected Route Access Control
testCases.description: Verify unauthenticated users cannot access protected routes
steps: Clear localStorage to ensure no authentication token exists
Confirm no dashboard content is visible
Check that loading spinner appears briefly during auth check
testCases.expectedOutcome: Unauthenticated users are immediately redirected to login page when attempting to access protected routes
testCases.failureCondition: Dashboard is accessible without authentication or no redirect occurs

testCases.name: JWT Token Verification
testCases.description: Test JWT token verification on protected endpoints
steps: Register or login to obtain valid JWT token
Make GET request to /api/auth/verify with valid token in Authorization header
Verify 403 response with 'Invalid or expired token' message
Verify 401 response with 'Access token required' message
testCases.expectedOutcome: Valid tokens are accepted, invalid tokens are rejected with appropriate error messages
testCases.failureCondition: Invalid tokens accepted or valid tokens rejected

testCases.name: Session Persistence on Page Refresh
testCases.description: Test that user session persists after page refresh using Zustand persist
steps: Refresh the browser page (F5 or Cmd+R)
Confirm dashboard still displays user information
Verify no redirect to login page occurs
Confirm initialize_auth function executed on mount
testCases.expectedOutcome: User session persists across page refreshes, user remains logged in
testCases.failureCondition: User is logged out after refresh or redirected to login

testCases.name: Registration Email Validation
testCases.description: Test email validation during registration
testCases.expectedOutcome: Invalid email formats are rejected, valid formats accepted
testCases.failureCondition: Invalid emails accepted or valid emails rejected

testCases.name: Registration Password Length Validation
testCases.description: Test password length validation (minimum 6 characters)
steps: Verify error message: 'Password must be at least 6 characters long'
Verify registration proceeds (if email is new)
testCases.expectedOutcome: Passwords shorter than 6 characters are rejected with clear error message
testCases.failureCondition: Short passwords accepted or no error message displayed

testCases.name: Registration Name Field Validation
testCases.description: Test that name field is required during registration
steps: Or verify backend returns 'All fields are required' error
testCases.expectedOutcome: Empty name field prevents registration
testCases.failureCondition: Registration succeeds without name

testCases.name: Duplicate Email Registration Prevention
testCases.description: Test that duplicate email addresses are rejected
steps: Attempt to register again with same email: 'duplicate@example.com'
Verify error message: 'User with this email already exists'
Confirm no second user account created
testCases.expectedOutcome: Duplicate email registration is rejected with clear error message
testCases.failureCondition: Multiple accounts created with same email

testCases.name: Login with Invalid Credentials
testCases.description: Test error handling for invalid login credentials
steps: Verify error message: 'Invalid email or password'
Test with existing email but wrong password
Verify same generic error message (security best practice)
testCases.expectedOutcome: Invalid credentials rejected with generic error message, no specific indication of which field is wrong
testCases.failureCondition: Login succeeds with invalid credentials or error reveals which field is incorrect

testCases.name: Login with Missing Fields
testCases.description: Test validation when login fields are empty
steps: Verify HTML5 validation or error message
testCases.expectedOutcome: Form cannot be submitted with missing required fields
testCases.failureCondition: Incomplete form is submitted

testCases.name: Error Message Display
testCases.description: Test that error messages are properly displayed to users
steps: Trigger various errors (invalid login, duplicate email, etc.)
Verify error message appears in red alert box
Check error message styling (red background, border, text)
Verify error is stored in Zustand store
Verify error clears when mode changes (clear_auth_error called)
testCases.expectedOutcome: Error messages displayed prominently with clear styling and proper clearing behavior
testCases.failureCondition: Errors not visible or persist when they shouldn't

testCases.name: Loading State Indicators
testCases.description: Test loading indicators during async operations
steps: Verify button is disabled during loading
Confirm loading state ends when response received
Test loading spinner on initial app load (auth initialization)
testCases.expectedOutcome: Loading indicators appear during all async operations, buttons disabled to prevent double-submission
testCases.failureCondition: No loading indicators or users can submit multiple times

testCases.name: Dashboard User Information Display
testCases.description: Test that user information is correctly displayed in dashboard
steps: Login as test user with known credentials
Verify welcome message includes user name: 'Welcome back, [Name]!'
Confirm data matches the authenticated user
Verify data is pulled from Zustand store current_user object
testCases.expectedOutcome: User information accurately displayed in dashboard matching authenticated user data
testCases.failureCondition: Wrong user info displayed or missing data

testCases.name: User Profile Update
testCases.description: Test user profile update functionality
steps: Or make direct API call to PUT /api/auth/profile
Update name field to new value: 'Updated Name'
Confirm updated name appears in dashboard
Verify Zustand store updated with new name
Refresh page and confirm name persists
testCases.expectedOutcome: User profile updates successfully, changes persist and reflect across app
testCases.failureCondition: Update fails or changes don't persist
testCases.note: Profile update UI may not be fully implemented - test via API

testCases.name: Protected API Endpoint Access
testCases.description: Test access control on protected API endpoints
steps: Obtain valid JWT token via login
Make GET request to /api/protected with Authorization: Bearer <token>
Verify 200 response with success message and user data
testCases.expectedOutcome: Protected endpoints require valid JWT, reject requests without proper authentication
testCases.failureCondition: Protected endpoints accessible without authentication

testCases.name: Current User Endpoint
testCases.description: Test /api/auth/me endpoint returns current user data
steps: Make GET request to /api/auth/me with valid token
Check user object has id, email, name, created_at fields
testCases.expectedOutcome: Endpoint returns current authenticated user data when valid token provided
testCases.failureCondition: Wrong user data returned or endpoint accessible without auth

testCases.name: Email Address Normalization
testCases.description: Test that email addresses are normalized (lowercase, trimmed)
steps: Check email is stored as: 'testuser@example.com' (lowercase, trimmed)
Attempt to login with various formats:
Verify all formats successfully login to same account
testCases.expectedOutcome: Email addresses normalized to lowercase and trimmed, login works with any case variation
testCases.failureCondition: Case-sensitive email matching or whitespace issues

testCases.name: Name Field Trimming
testCases.description: Test that name field is trimmed of leading/trailing whitespace
steps: Register with name: '  Test User  ' (spaces before and after)
Verify dashboard displays trimmed name without extra spaces
testCases.expectedOutcome: Name field properly trimmed before storage
testCases.failureCondition: Extra whitespace stored in database

testCases.name: Toggle Between Login and Registration Modes
testCases.description: Test switching between login and registration forms
steps: Verify form shows email and password fields only
Verify heading: 'Sign in to your account'
Click 'Don't have an account? Sign up' link
Verify form now shows name, email, and password fields
Verify heading changes to: 'Create your account'
Verify button text changes to 'Create account'
Verify any error messages are cleared
Click 'Already have an account? Sign in'
Verify form returns to login mode
Confirm form fields and errors reset
testCases.expectedOutcome: Smooth transition between modes, form resets properly, errors cleared
testCases.failureCondition: Mode doesn't switch or form state persists incorrectly

testCases.name: Responsive Design on Mobile Devices
testCases.description: Test application responsiveness on different screen sizes
steps: Verify layout is centered with max-width constraint
Verify form remains usable and properly sized
Test form inputs are appropriately sized for touch
testCases.expectedOutcome: Application is fully functional and visually correct on all screen sizes
testCases.failureCondition: Layout breaks, elements overlap, or horizontal scroll appears

testCases.name: JWT Token Expiration Handling
testCases.description: Test application behavior when JWT token expires (7-day expiration)
steps: Note: Token expires in 7 days (as configured in server.ts)
Manually create expired token for testing
Check auth state cleared from store
testCases.expectedOutcome: Expired tokens detected and user logged out automatically
testCases.failureCondition: Expired tokens accepted or user remains logged in
testCases.note: May require manual token manipulation for testing

testCases.name: Password Hashing Security
testCases.description: Verify passwords are securely hashed using bcrypt
steps: Query database directly or inspect API response
Verify password field contains bcrypt hash, not plain text
Check hash starts with '$2b$12$' (bcrypt with 12 salt rounds)
Register same password for different user
Confirm hashes are different (salt is unique)
Attempt to login with correct password
testCases.expectedOutcome: All passwords stored as bcrypt hashes, never in plain text
testCases.failureCondition: Plain text passwords in database
testCases.note: Requires database access or backend testing

testCases.name: CORS Configuration
testCases.description: Test CORS is properly configured for frontend-backend communication
steps: Make API request from frontend to backend
Verify request succeeds without CORS errors
Check response headers include appropriate CORS headers
Verify frontend URL is allowed origin
testCases.expectedOutcome: CORS properly configured, frontend can communicate with backend
testCases.failureCondition: CORS errors prevent frontend-backend communication

testCases.name: Navigation and Redirect Behavior
testCases.description: Test application routing and redirect logic
steps: Verify redirect to /dashboard (if authenticated) or /login (if not)
While logged in, attempt to navigate to /login
Verify behavior (allow or redirect to dashboard)
Test catch-all route '/*' redirects to appropriate page
Verify react-router-dom Navigate component works correctly
testCases.expectedOutcome: All navigation paths work correctly, appropriate redirects occur
testCases.failureCondition: Navigation broken or incorrect redirects

testCases.name: Zustand Store Persistence Configuration
testCases.description: Test Zustand persist middleware configuration
steps: Verify stored data includes: current_user, auth_token, is_authenticated
Verify is_loading is NOT persisted (always false in storage)
Verify error_message is NOT persisted (always null in storage)
testCases.expectedOutcome: Only necessary auth data persisted, sensitive/temporary data excluded
testCases.failureCondition: Incorrect data persisted or state not properly rehydrated

testCases.name: Backend Health Check Endpoint
testCases.description: Test backend is running and responding
steps: Verify response JSON: { message: 'cofounder backend boilerplate :)' }
testCases.expectedOutcome: Backend responds with success message
testCases.failureCondition: Backend not responding or error returned

testCases.name: Application Load Time Performance
testCases.description: Test application loads within acceptable time
steps: Verify page loads in under 3 seconds on good connection
testCases.expectedOutcome: Application loads quickly with optimized assets
testCases.failureCondition: Slow load times or large bundle sizes
testCases.note: Use browser DevTools or Lighthouse for measurement

test_execution_notes: Automated tests can be run using: npm test or npm run test:e2e
Some tests require manual execution for visual and UX verification
API tests can be automated using Jest + Supertest in backend
Frontend tests use Vitest + Testing Library
Create unique email addresses for each test run to avoid conflicts
Consider using test database for backend tests to avoid polluting production data
JWT tokens expire in 7 days - plan long-term tests accordingly

priority_definitions.critical: Must pass - core functionality, blocks release if failing
priority_definitions.high: Should pass - important features, investigate failures promptly
priority_definitions.medium: Nice to pass - quality of life features, fix when possible
priority_definitions.low: Optional - non-critical features, fix if time permits
